## Scope

This report summarizes Step 1 Google RSS retrieval outputs across pathogen
domain-language datasets. It is designed for the hierarchical scan strategy:

- `whole_period`
- `5_year`
- `30_day (monthly)`
- `14_day`
- `7_day`
- `3_day`
- `1_day`

The report reads the manifest-derived scan summaries written by
`src/rss_retrieval/retrieve_google_rss.py`.

```{python}
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import yaml
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown, display

pd.set_option("display.max_columns", 200)
pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth", 200)


def find_repo_root(start: Path) -> Path:
    for path in [start, *start.parents]:
        if (path / "src").exists() and (path / "data").exists():
            return path
    raise RuntimeError("Could not locate repository root from the working directory.")


def note_df(message: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return pd.DataFrame({"note": [message]})


def html_table(df: pd.DataFrame) -> HTML:
    if df.empty:
        return HTML("<p><em>No rows available.</em></p>")
    shown = df.copy()
    for column in shown.columns:
        if pd.api.types.is_float_dtype(shown[column]):
            shown[column] = shown[column].round(2)
    return HTML(shown.to_html(index=False, escape=False, border=0))


ROOT = find_repo_root(Path.cwd())
CONFIG_PATH = ROOT / "src" / "config" / "pipeline.yaml"
CONFIG = yaml.safe_load(CONFIG_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) or {}

DATA_ROOT = ROOT / str(CONFIG.get("paths", {}).get("data_root", "data"))
RSS_RAW_ROOT = DATA_ROOT / "raw" / "rss"
RSS_INTERMEDIATE_ROOT = DATA_ROOT / "intermediate" / "rss"

RSS_CFG = CONFIG.get("rss", {})
COARSE_SCAN_YEARS = int(RSS_CFG.get("coarse_scan_years", 5))
WINDOW_HIERARCHY = sorted(
    {int(value) for value in RSS_CFG.get("split_hierarchy_days", [30, 14, 7, 3, 1])},
    reverse=True,
)
if 1 not in WINDOW_HIERARCHY:
    WINDOW_HIERARCHY.append(1)

EXPECTED_STAGE_LABELS = [
    "whole_period",
    f"{COARSE_SCAN_YEARS}_year",
    *[f"{days}_day" for days in WINDOW_HIERARCHY],
]
EXPECTED_STAGE_DISPLAY = {
    "whole_period": "Whole period",
    f"{COARSE_SCAN_YEARS}_year": f"{COARSE_SCAN_YEARS}-year",
    **{
        f"{days}_day": ("30-day (monthly)" if days == 30 else f"{days}-day")
        for days in WINDOW_HIERARCHY
    },
}
EXPECTED_STAGE_RANK = {
    stage_label: rank for rank, stage_label in enumerate(EXPECTED_STAGE_LABELS)
}

summary_paths = sorted(RSS_INTERMEDIATE_ROOT.glob("*_scan_summary.csv"))
manifest_paths = sorted(RSS_RAW_ROOT.glob("*/*_manifest.csv"))
rss_output_paths = sorted(
    path
    for path in RSS_INTERMEDIATE_ROOT.glob("*.csv")
    if not path.name.endswith("_scan_summary.csv") and not path.name.endswith("_metrics.csv")
)

summary_frames = []
for path in summary_paths:
    frame = pd.read_csv(path)
    frame["summary_path"] = str(path.relative_to(ROOT))
    summary_frames.append(frame)

scan_df = pd.concat(summary_frames, ignore_index=True) if summary_frames else pd.DataFrame()

if not scan_df.empty:
    for column in [
        "stage_rank",
        "window_days",
        "entry_count",
        "split_trigger_entries",
        "elapsed_request_seconds",
    ]:
        scan_df[column] = pd.to_numeric(scan_df[column], errors="coerce")
    if "stage_label" not in scan_df.columns:
        scan_df["stage_label"] = ""
    if "stage_display" not in scan_df.columns:
        scan_df["stage_display"] = scan_df["stage_label"].map(EXPECTED_STAGE_DISPLAY).fillna(scan_df["stage_label"])
    scan_df["stage_rank"] = scan_df["stage_label"].map(EXPECTED_STAGE_RANK).fillna(scan_df["stage_rank"])
    scan_df["stage_rank"] = pd.to_numeric(scan_df["stage_rank"], errors="coerce").fillna(999).astype(int)
    scan_df["entry_count"] = pd.to_numeric(scan_df["entry_count"], errors="coerce")
    scan_df["window_days"] = pd.to_numeric(scan_df["window_days"], errors="coerce")
else:
    scan_df = pd.DataFrame(
        columns=[
            "dataset_key",
            "pathogen_domain",
            "language_code",
            "locale_id",
            "search_string",
            "stage_label",
            "stage_display",
            "stage_rank",
            "window_role",
            "window_start",
            "window_end",
            "window_days",
            "status",
            "elapsed_request_seconds",
            "entry_count",
            "threshold_bucket",
            "next_action",
            "error_summary",
            "summary_path",
        ]
    )

manifest_rows = []
for path in manifest_paths:
    dataset_key = path.stem.removesuffix("_manifest")
    exists = path.exists()
    row_count = pd.read_csv(path, dtype=str).shape[0] if exists else 0
    manifest_rows.append(
        {
            "dataset_key": dataset_key,
            "manifest_path": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),
            "manifest_rows": row_count,
            "manifest_modified": datetime.fromtimestamp(path.stat().st_mtime).isoformat(timespec="seconds") if exists else None,
        }
    )
manifest_df = pd.DataFrame(manifest_rows)

summary_artifacts = []
for path in summary_paths:
    dataset_key = path.stem.removesuffix("_scan_summary")
    frame = pd.read_csv(path)
    summary_artifacts.append(
        {
            "dataset_key": dataset_key,
            "scan_summary_path": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),
            "scan_rows": len(frame),
            "scan_modified": datetime.fromtimestamp(path.stat().st_mtime).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        }
    )
summary_artifacts_df = pd.DataFrame(summary_artifacts)

output_rows = []
for path in rss_output_paths:
    dataset_key = path.stem
    row_count = pd.read_csv(path, low_memory=False).shape[0]
    output_rows.append(
        {
            "dataset_key": dataset_key,
            "rss_output_path": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),
            "rss_output_rows": row_count,
            "rss_output_modified": datetime.fromtimestamp(path.stat().st_mtime).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        }
    )
output_df = pd.DataFrame(output_rows)

artifacts_df = (
    manifest_df.merge(summary_artifacts_df, on="dataset_key", how="outer")
    .merge(output_df, on="dataset_key", how="outer")
    .sort_values("dataset_key", kind="stable")
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)
```

## Retrieval Ladder

```{python}
ladder = [
    "flowchart LR",
    '  A["Whole period"] --> B["5-year periods"]',
]

previous = "B"
for days in WINDOW_HIERARCHY:
    node_name = f"D{days}"
    label = "30-day (monthly)" if days == 30 else f"{days}-day"
    ladder.append(f'  {previous} --> {node_name}["{label}"]')
    previous = node_name

display(Markdown("```mermaid\n" + "\n".join(ladder) + "\n```"))
```

## Artifacts

```{python}
if artifacts_df.empty:
    note_df("No Step 1 artifacts found yet. Start RSS retrieval before rendering this report.")
else:
    html_table(artifacts_df.fillna(""))
```

## Overall Progress

```{python}
if scan_df.empty:
    note_df("No scan summaries are available yet.")
else:
    total_unique_queries = (
        scan_df[["dataset_key", "search_string"]]
        .drop_duplicates()
        .shape[0]
    )
    summary_metrics = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {"metric": "datasets_with_scan_summary", "value": int(scan_df["dataset_key"].nunique())},
            {"metric": "locale_variants_observed", "value": int(scan_df["locale_id"].nunique())},
            {"metric": "unique_search_strings", "value": int(total_unique_queries)},
            {"metric": "window_rows", "value": int(len(scan_df))},
            {"metric": "success_rows", "value": int((scan_df["status"] == "success").sum())},
            {"metric": "empty_rows", "value": int((scan_df["status"] == "empty").sum())},
            {"metric": "split_rows", "value": int((scan_df["status"] == "split").sum())},
            {"metric": "retry_needed_rows", "value": int(scan_df["next_action"].eq("retry_needed").sum())},
            {"metric": "pending_rows", "value": int(scan_df["next_action"].eq("pending").sum())},
            {"metric": "tracked_request_seconds", "value": float(scan_df["elapsed_request_seconds"].fillna(0).sum())},
        ]
    )
    html_table(summary_metrics)
```

## Stage-by-Dataset Summary

```{python}
if scan_df.empty:
    note_df("No stage-level scan rows found.")
else:
    stage_dataset_summary = (
        scan_df.groupby(["dataset_key", "stage_rank", "stage_display"], dropna=False)
        .agg(
            window_rows=("search_string", "size"),
            unique_search_strings=("search_string", "nunique"),
            split_rows=("status", lambda values: int((values == "split").sum())),
            success_rows=("status", lambda values: int((values == "success").sum())),
            empty_rows=("status", lambda values: int((values == "empty").sum())),
            retry_needed_rows=("next_action", lambda values: int((values == "retry_needed").sum())),
            tracked_request_seconds=("elapsed_request_seconds", "sum"),
            median_entry_count=("entry_count", "median"),
            max_entry_count=("entry_count", "max"),
        )
        .reset_index()
        .sort_values(["dataset_key", "stage_rank"], kind="stable")
    )
    html_table(stage_dataset_summary.fillna(""))
```

## Unique Search Strings by Deepest Stage Reached

```{python}
if scan_df.empty:
    note_df("No deepest-stage summary available yet.")
else:
    deepest_stage = (
        scan_df.sort_values(["dataset_key", "search_string", "stage_rank"], kind="stable")
        .groupby(["dataset_key", "search_string"], as_index=False)
        .tail(1)
    )
    deepest_summary = (
        deepest_stage.groupby(["dataset_key", "stage_rank", "stage_display"], dropna=False)
        .size()
        .reset_index(name="unique_search_strings")
        .sort_values(["dataset_key", "stage_rank"], kind="stable")
    )
    html_table(deepest_summary)
```

## Stage Details

```{python}
if scan_df.empty:
    display(note_df("No scan-summary rows are available, so stage details are not yet populated."))
else:
    stage_labels_in_data = (
        scan_df[["stage_label", "stage_display", "stage_rank"]]
        .drop_duplicates()
        .sort_values(["stage_rank", "stage_display"], kind="stable")
    )

    for stage in stage_labels_in_data.to_dict(orient="records"):
        stage_label = stage["stage_label"]
        stage_display = stage["stage_display"]
        stage_slice = scan_df.loc[scan_df["stage_label"] == stage_label].copy()

        display(Markdown(f"### {stage_display}"))

        stage_metrics = pd.DataFrame(
            [
                {"metric": "window_rows", "value": int(len(stage_slice))},
                {"metric": "datasets", "value": int(stage_slice["dataset_key"].nunique())},
                {"metric": "unique_search_strings", "value": int(stage_slice["search_string"].nunique())},
                {"metric": "split_rows", "value": int((stage_slice["status"] == "split").sum())},
                {"metric": "success_rows", "value": int((stage_slice["status"] == "success").sum())},
                {"metric": "empty_rows", "value": int((stage_slice["status"] == "empty").sum())},
                {"metric": "retry_needed_rows", "value": int(stage_slice["next_action"].eq("retry_needed").sum())},
                {"metric": "pending_rows", "value": int(stage_slice["next_action"].eq("pending").sum())},
                {"metric": "at_or_above_threshold_rows", "value": int(stage_slice["threshold_bucket"].eq("at_or_above_threshold").sum())},
                {"metric": "tracked_request_seconds", "value": float(stage_slice["elapsed_request_seconds"].fillna(0).sum())},
            ]
        )
        display(html_table(stage_metrics))

        dataset_breakdown = (
            stage_slice.groupby(["dataset_key", "status", "next_action"], dropna=False)
            .agg(
                window_rows=("search_string", "size"),
                unique_search_strings=("search_string", "nunique"),
                tracked_request_seconds=("elapsed_request_seconds", "sum"),
                median_entry_count=("entry_count", "median"),
                max_entry_count=("entry_count", "max"),
            )
            .reset_index()
            .sort_values(["dataset_key", "status", "next_action"], kind="stable")
        )
        display(Markdown("#### Dataset status breakdown"))
        display(html_table(dataset_breakdown.fillna("")))

        threshold_breakdown = (
            stage_slice.groupby(["dataset_key", "threshold_bucket"], dropna=False)
            .agg(
                window_rows=("search_string", "size"),
                unique_search_strings=("search_string", "nunique"),
            )
            .reset_index()
            .sort_values(["dataset_key", "threshold_bucket"], kind="stable")
        )
        display(Markdown("#### Threshold breakdown"))
        display(html_table(threshold_breakdown))

        hotspots = (
            stage_slice.loc[stage_slice["status"] == "split", [
                "dataset_key",
                "locale_id",
                "search_string",
                "window_start",
                "window_end",
                "entry_count",
                "error_summary",
            ]]
            .sort_values(["entry_count", "dataset_key", "search_string"], ascending=[False, True, True], kind="stable")
            .head(20)
        )
        display(Markdown("#### Largest split-triggering windows"))
        display(html_table(hotspots.fillna("")))
```

## Outstanding Retry or Pending Work

```{python}
if scan_df.empty:
    note_df("No pending or retry rows available.")
else:
    retry_or_pending = (
        scan_df.loc[scan_df["next_action"].isin(["retry_needed", "pending"]), [
            "dataset_key",
            "stage_display",
            "locale_id",
            "search_string",
            "window_start",
            "window_end",
            "status",
            "next_action",
            "error_summary",
        ]]
        .sort_values(
            ["dataset_key", "stage_rank", "locale_id", "search_string", "window_start"],
            kind="stable",
        )
        .head(200)
    )
    html_table(retry_or_pending.fillna(""))
```
